slave 1 rejected the "Read Coils" request: Gateway path unavailable — the gateway could not forward the request to the target device

── Byte-by-byte ──
00 01  Transaction identifier  Sequence number 0x0001 assigned by the master to this exchange; the response echoes it
00 00  Protocol identifier     0x0000 = standard Modbus protocol
00 03  Length                  3 more bytes follow (unit identifier + data)
01     Unit identifier         slave address: device 1
81     Function code           0x81 = 0x01 + 0x80, meaning "Read Coils" raised an exception
0A     Exception code          0x0A = Gateway path unavailable — the gateway could not forward the request to the target device
